definition: [ כִּרְכָּרָה ] noun feminine dromedary (according to Ki Thes ; perhaps from constantly repeated undulating movement); — only plural absolute וּבַכִּרְכָּרוֺת Isa 66:20 (+ בַּסּוּסִים וּבָרֶכֶב וּבַצַּבִּים וּבַפְּרָדִים ; the whole list is a gloss according to Du Che Intr Is .).
